definitions.gloss: cold treatment; inhospitable reception; being treated poorly
definitions.explanation: Being treated coldly or unfavorably, especially in a professional or social setting. The opposite of preferential or warm treatment.

examples.japanese: {冷遇|れいぐう}⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{悲|かな}しかった→悲しい：00783_kanashii⟧。
examples.english: I was saddened by the cold treatment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧、⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{冷遇|れいぐう}⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{気|き}づいた。
examples.english: After changing jobs, I realized I had been treated poorly at my previous company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{功績|こうせき}→功績：04143_kouseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧にもかかわらず{冷遇|れいぐう}⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}なくない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: There are quite a few employees who are treated poorly despite their achievements.

notes:
{冷遇|れいぐう} means cold or unfavorable treatment, especially in professional or institutional settings. Composed of {冷|れい} (cold) + {遇|ぐう} (treatment).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冷遇|れいぐう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to treat coldly
- {冷遇|れいぐう}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be treated coldly
- {冷遇|れいぐう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive cold treatment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{優遇|ゆうぐう}→優遇：17162_yuuguu⟧: preferential treatment (positive)
- {厚遇|こうぐう}: generous treatment (positive)
- {冷遇|れいぐう}: cold treatment (negative)

Note: All three share the {遇|ぐう} (treatment) component.

REGISTER:
Formal. Common in workplace discussions, news, and written contexts. In casual speech, people might say ⟦{冷|つめ}たく→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ or ⟦{無視|むし}される→無視する：17288_mushisuru⟧ instead.
